solutions.title: Recursive memoization
solutions.strategy: Define a state `(i, j)` for text suffix `s[i:]` and pattern suffix `p[j:]`; memoize the skip-or-consume decisions around `*`.

timeComplexity.explanation: There are at most `(m + 1) * (n + 1)` text/pattern states and each state does constant transition work.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The memo table and recursion stack store state results; the stack depth is bounded by `m + n` and the table dominates.

solutions.title: Bottom-up DP
solutions.strategy: Fill the same state table from the end of the text and pattern toward the beginning.

timeComplexity.explanation: Every state in the DP table is computed once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The boolean table stores all suffix-match answers.
